accessibility.description: Class of '09 Access adds NVDA speech for menus and dialogue choices, plus arrow-key navigation for the main menu on Windows. Story dialogue uses the game's existing voice acting, avoiding the built-in self-voicing issue that skips spoken lines. NVDA must be running. The author reports that some menus remain tricky to navigate; Steam and GOG build compatibility has not been independently verified.
